about: The moments at which the OCPF BC Agentic Development Framework consults a loaded Custom Skill (Ops § Custom Skills). A skill's ocpf-skill.json may name only the keys below; 'active' points are consulted by this version at the places named, 'reserved' points are declared for a later version and a skill that names one is refused at load (it would otherwise silently not apply). Fetched into ocpfFramework/extensionPoints.json beside the Operations Guide; update-framework compares the new file with the loaded skills before it updates.

referenceSources.supplies: Markdown files the agent reads before writing code, beside the Standards Guide and the patterns library

preReviewChecks.supplies: a checklist the ocpf-reviewer reads beside the Standards sections

codeReviewChecks.supplies: a checklist the Code Review reads; additive, never relaxing a Standards rule

documents.supplies: a document the framework does not have: a template plus the step that writes it

steps.supplies: a step inserted between two framework steps, with its own exit gate, usage window, and options box

intakeQuestions.supplies: extra questions in a named intake box

analyzeOutputs.supplies: an extra document the analyze skill writes into requirements/existing/

documentTemplates.supplies: the skill's template replaces the framework's for a named document; headings may be added, never removed
consultedAt: the documents skill, when it reads a template

modelRecommendations.supplies: the recommended model and effort per role that the roles skill offers first; the human still chooses
consultedAt: the roles skill, kickoff boxes K5 and K6

companionOffers.supplies: Build-a-Feature's offer at an object's close, per object type

neverOverridable: the options box at every close
the Standards Guide's rules (a skill may add rules, never relax one)
